description: This file defines a thread-safe reference-counted smart pointer class 'linked_ptr' with internal management via 'linked_ptr_internal'. It includes class definitions, methods for managing object lifetime, and thread safety mechanisms, specifically for use within the Google Test internal namespace.

classes.name: linked_ptr_internal
classes.description: Internal class managing circular linked list of linked_ptr objects for reference tracking.

classes.name: linked_ptr
classes.description: Template class implementing a thread-safe reference-counted smart pointer with circular linked list management.

methods.name: join_new
methods.description: Initializes the internal linked list with a single node.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins an existing circular linked list of linked_ptr objects.

methods.name: depart
methods.description: Removes the current node from the circular linked list; deletes the managed object if it was the last reference.

methods.name: linked_ptr
methods.description: Constructor that takes ownership of a raw pointer.

methods.name: ~linked_ptr
methods.description: Destructor that departs from the linked list and deletes the object if last reference.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Replaces the managed object with a new raw pointer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the raw pointer to the managed object.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides access to the managed object's members.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison with raw pointer or another linked_ptr.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison with raw pointer or another linked_ptr.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies reference from another linked_ptr, joining the circular list.

methods.name: make_linked_ptr
methods.description: Factory function to create a linked_ptr from a raw pointer.
